The 2001 Canadian Grand Prix (round 8, held at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve on 10 June 2001) was won by Ralf Schumacher driving for Williams. He started from second on the grid. Michael Schumacher (Ferrari) finished second and Mika Häkkinen (McLaren) third.

ANSWER: Ralf Schumacher
